async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Click on the first issue link that has 'feature' in its title (which is the latest created due to current sorting)
    # The accessibility tree shows the first issue link after the sorting group is '[Feature suggestion] Support linking to an accessibility statement'
    # Use get_by_role with the exact name to ensure we click the correct link
    first_issue_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="[Feature suggestion] Support linking to an accessibility statement", exact=True)
    await first_issue_link.click()
    # Wait for the issue page to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Step 2: Check if the issue is closed by looking for 'Closed' or 'Open' text
    # Use get_by_text to find the status indicator
    closed_text = page.get_by_text("Closed", exact=True)
    open_text = page.get_by_text("Open", exact=True)
    if await closed_text.is_visible():
        status = "closed"
    elif await open_text.is_visible():
        status = "open"
    else:
        status = "status not found"
    return status
